protocol: Regenerate each frozen world and recheck root/frame/delta/bridge hashes before candidate execution.
Run the byte-frozen R18 candidate first with its original fixed input-occurrence elimination order and resource limits.
If candidate is nonterminal by resource limit, do not run the semantic verifier and score OPEN_RESOURCE_LIMIT.
Only after candidate terminal, run independent Minisat22 on the original frame for every bridge assignment and replay each SAT model.
Evaluate the frozen candidate DAG directly on every bridge assignment.
Compare complete allowed-mask sets and hashes.
promotion_rule: Only four of four PASS_EXACT_POST_DISCOVERY_CONTROL authorizes creation of a genuinely fresh prospective R19 unseen selector. Any mismatch freezes a counterexample. Any resource OPEN localizes candidate scaling without becoming semantic negative evidence.
claim_ceiling: Even 4/4 control success is not fresh structural unseen generalization because the control structures were already exposed in R16. It authorizes R19 only.
